title: Jungle DuckGod
tagline: Welcome to the Jungle. Rooted within Aztec culture, this next phase teleports us back to the creation of the SupDucks Universe.
description:
Launching this year, the SupDucks Jungle Duck God explores the lore, culture and backstory behind the infamous SupDucks NFT project. 

The dream-team of 3 -- comprised of both developers and artists -- joined forces in SF to build, code, draw, and design the entire experience created so far, from entering the Jungle to finding the Duck God. We built animated UI, integrated ENS, mintable Polygon NFTs and Balance fetching.
how_its_made:
We built this in NextJS with StyledComponents and Framer Motion.
Using ENSJS, ThirdWeb, Covalent and FileCoin to host our Art.

We plan to deploy this to the public soon. And are hoping to continue using some of the technology from the Hackathon.

Learn more at http://www.supducks.com
